The M, further described by Mora and Ruiz-Castillo (2011) <doi:10.1111/j.1467-9531.2011.01237.x> and Frankel and Volij (2011) <doi:10.1016/j.jet.2010.10.008>,  is a measure of segregation that is highly decomposable. The package provides tools to decompose the index by units and groups (local segregation),  and by within and between terms. Includes standard error estimation by bootstrapping.
